headline: New rendered-byte leakage audit for the strongest existing binding-generator donor (trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2.py) confirms H5's counterhypothesis: pairwise zero-MI was insufficient. Found a real ~0.276-bit joint leak between routed target symbol and (codebook-order|mapping|layout|polarity) x template, not visible to the blueprint's own pairwise selftest.
state: Per TRIGGERWORT_2 course Step 6 (positive admission gates closed -> build generators/labelers/nuisance-controls/evals only, do not inflate accepted tokens) and per V35 delta guidance to rebase/audit the strongest existing donor rather than fork a new generator: added tools/trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2_leakage_audit_v1.py + tests/test_trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2_leakage_audit_v1.py (6/6 pass, run via `python3 -m pytest`). Audit renders full prompt bytes (codebook + evidence/query, placeholder ABI_ACCEPTED_ORDINAL atoms, real tokenizer binding remains a separate later gate) from the existing v2.1 blueprint and checks: (1) exact prompt uniqueness -- PASS, 9072/9072 unique; (2) cross-split (TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT_FROZEN) exact content disjointness -- PASS, zero overlap; (3) text-conditional target uniformity, i.e. for every one of 72 distinct evidence+query texts a model could see, the routed target symbol is exactly uniform across the full mapping x codebook-order product -- PASS, proves no pure lexical shortcut on text alone; (4) higher-order joint mutual information between target/class and 2-way nuisance-field combinations -- FAIL: target__permxt, target__ordxt, target__layxt, target__pxt each ~0.276 bits (class-level joint MI stays clean, only the routed SYMBOL leaks, not the semantic class); (5) dependency-free bag-of-words shortcut classifier (5-fold CV within TRAIN, candidates restricted to each row's own valid symbol triple) -- borderline, 28.1% vs 33.3% chance, no evidence of an exploitable lexical shortcut consistent with finding (3). accepted_dataset_tokens remains 0; training_credit remains 0; this is tooling + a nuisance finding, not an admission event.
next: Root-cause and fix the perm/ord/layout/polarity x template interaction in trigger2_dynamic_binding_blueprint_v2.py or its successor (likely: the per-template triple-crossing needs balancing so every (nuisance-field, template) cell is represented with equal frequency within each split, not just each field marginally). Rerun this audit after any generator change -- test_higher_order_joint_mi_finds_the_known_open_leak is intentionally written to FAIL today so a future fix shows up as a real, observed regression-test flip rather than being silently re-passed by accident. Then continue the still-open PR #1956 next-exact-gates list (exact 46-atom ABI inventory/manifest, small audited pilot materialization, joint TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT split-manifest construction) before any admission attempt.
